note: Investor-type presets (researched taxonomy, 7 Oct 2026). A preset only chooses a tier, segments and published figures. It cannot touch the locked core; any other key, an unknown segment or stat, a dropped type or a nationality-defined type is rejected. status 'draft' means: needs an official check before client use.

order_flags.title: Buying more than one home
order_flags.note: Several homes in one order: this report describes each home size separately. It does not add prices together or say what a combined purchase qualifies for.

languages.note: Nationality may pick the language of a report, never its content.

rule_cards.note: A dated, sourced official rule card goes here. Empty means the report states no rule, threshold or eligibility. Shape: { text, threshold_aed, source, url, as_of }.

presets.title: Prime or wealthy, price-led
presets.blurb: Registered prices against the best nearby sales, who else bought, how many sold.

presets.title: Yield or rental income
presets.blurb: Rent contracts and the yield method, with what is not known.
presets.needs_check: Thin evidence: the rent data is partial. Needs an official check before client use.

presets.title: Capital growth, long hold
presets.blurb: For the investor who holds through handover and beyond: past registered prices and sales pace, said as history only.

presets.title: Flipper or short-term trader
presets.blurb: Payment plan, cash before handover, registered resale activity, fees and how the developer has delivered. Conditions for resale differ by developer.
presets.needs_check: The conditions for resale before handover are not stated until a dated official rule card exists. Needs an official check before client use.

presets.title: Residency-led (Golden Visa)
presets.blurb: Registered prices by home size and the build status. The visa rule is stated only from a dated official rule card.
presets.needs_check: The Golden Visa rule reads differently across sources. Needs a dated rule card from the official service page before client use.

presets.title: Overseas first-timer
presets.blurb: Short first, then the buyer protections in full evidence.

presets.title: UAE-resident investor
presets.blurb: Prices by home size, the handover and the developer, for someone already living here.

presets.title: Family, community- or school-led
presets.blurb: Short and story-led: the home, the place, the handover.

presets.title: Relocating professional
presets.blurb: Short: sizes, the place and when it is due.

presets.title: Tenant converting to owner
presets.blurb: Sizes, prices, the handover and the developer, for someone moving from renting.

presets.title: Holiday or second home
presets.blurb: Short: the place, what the developer says, home sizes.
